briefdescription.para: Temporary type, when visit(..., nullptr) finishes will convert to one of the remaining types: Integer, FloatingPoint or Ambiguous.
Connected with instruction that interprets 'bags of bits' as integers.

detaileddescription.para: Select gprb to avoid cross bank copies.

briefdescription.para: Connected with instruction that interprets 'bags of bits' as floating point numbers.

detaileddescription.para: Select fprb to avoid cross bank copies.
Select same bank for entire chain to avoid cross bank copies. Currently we select fprb for s64 and gprb for s32 Ambiguous operands.
Unlike Ambiguous s64, AmbiguousWithMergeOrUnmerge s64 is mapped to gprb (legalized using narrow scalar to s32).

briefdescription.para: Some instructions are used with both floating point and integer operands.

detaileddescription.para: We assign InstType to such instructions as it helps us to avoid cross bank copies. InstType deppends on context.

briefdescription.para: Get the mapping of the different operands of MI on the register bank.

detaileddescription.para: This mapping should be the direct translation of MI. In other words, when MI is mapped with the returned mapping, only the register banks of the operands of MI need to be updated. In particular, neither the opcode nor the type of MI needs to be updated for this direct mapping.

The target independent implementation gives a mapping based on the register classes for the target specific opcode. It uses the ID RegisterBankInfo::DefaultMappingID for that mapping. Make sure you do not use that ID for the alternative mapping for MI. See getInstrAlternativeMappings for the alternative mappings.
For instance, if MI is a vector add, the mapping should not be a scalarization of the add.

simplesect.para: If returnedVal does not verify MI, this would probably mean that the target does not support that instruction.

briefdescription.para: Here we have to narrowScalar s64 operands to s32, combine away G_MERGE or G_UNMERGE and erase instructions that became dead in the process.

detaileddescription.para: We manually assign bank to def operand of all new instructions that were created in the process since they will not end up in RegBankSelect loop.

briefdescription.para: RegBankSelect determined that s64 operand is better to be split into two s32 operands in gprb.

detaileddescription.para: Here we manually set register banks of def operands of newly created instructions since they will not get regbankselected.

briefdescription.para: This class provides the information for the target register banks.
